description: Authored toy calibration phrases; positive/negative polarity is scoped solely to each human-defined axis. No vocabulary additions or authoritative contracts.

positive: A valid signatory approves the operation
The actor possesses permission to proceed
An empowered representative authorizes execution
negative: A valid signatory does not approve the operation
The actor possesses no permission to proceed
An empowered representative does not authorize execution

positive: The participant must fulfill a binding contractual duty
An enforceable commitment requires the party to act
The agreement compels completion of the undertaking
negative: The participant has no binding contractual duty to fulfill
No enforceable commitment requires the party to act
The agreement does not compel completion of the undertaking

positive: The operation draws upon a finite resource allocation
The step transfers control of a scarce asset
Limited computing capacity is reserved for the job
negative: The operation draws upon no finite resource allocation
The step does not transfer control of a scarce asset
No limited computing capacity is reserved for the job

positive: Auditable records substantiate the asserted claim
Independent observations support the proposition
Documentary proof establishes support for the request
negative: Auditable records do not substantiate the asserted claim
Independent observations do not support the proposition
Documentary proof does not establish support for the request

positive: A specified deadline limits when the task may complete
The authorization remains valid only during a time window
The work must follow a defined temporal ordering
negative: No specified deadline limits when the task may complete
The authorization has no time window limiting validity
The work has no defined temporal ordering

positive: Several outcomes remain plausible because the result is unknown
Available observations leave the decision unresolved
The interpretation of the current state remains ambiguous
negative: The result is known and no alternative outcome remains plausible
Available observations completely resolve the decision
The interpretation of the current state is unambiguous

positive: A binding restriction prohibits the two actions from coexisting
The proposed operation is explicitly disallowed
The governing conditions make the requested states incompatible
negative: No restriction prohibits the two actions from coexisting
The proposed operation is explicitly allowed
The governing conditions allow the requested states together

positive: Performing the action causes a specified state change
Execution produces a defined downstream effect
The contractual step alters the resulting condition
negative: Performing the action causes no state change
Execution produces no downstream effect
The contractual step leaves the resulting condition unchanged

positive: A recognized delegate has granted approval for this act
The requested action is authorized by an empowered principal
negative: A recognized delegate has withheld approval for this act
The requested action is not authorized by an empowered principal

positive: The governing terms require mandatory performance by the signer
A legally binding promise imposes a duty of execution
negative: The governing terms do not require mandatory performance by the signer
No legally binding promise imposes a duty of execution

positive: The transaction consumes a bounded pool of available capacity
A restricted allotment of resources changes ownership
negative: The transaction consumes no bounded pool of available capacity
No restricted allotment of resources changes ownership

positive: Reproducible measurements corroborate the finding
A traceable record supplies support for the assertion
negative: Reproducible measurements do not corroborate the finding
No traceable record supplies support for the assertion

positive: A fixed cutoff governs completion of the action
The task operates under an expiring validity period
negative: No fixed cutoff governs completion of the action
The task operates without an expiring validity period

positive: Present facts do not determine a unique outcome
More than one explanation fits the incomplete record
negative: Present facts determine a unique outcome
Exactly one explanation fits the complete record

positive: A prohibition rules out the requested joint action
The two states cannot simultaneously satisfy the applicable constraint
negative: No prohibition rules out the requested joint action
The two states can simultaneously satisfy the applicable constraint

positive: Completing the transaction changes what happens afterward
The operation yields a measurable transition of state
negative: Completing the transaction does not change what happens afterward
The operation yields no transition of state

positive: A competent official has issued valid consent
Execution carries explicit authorization from the rightful decision maker
negative: A competent official has not issued valid consent
Execution lacks authorization from the rightful decision maker

positive: The participant is obligated to deliver the promised work
A compulsory commitment has been imposed upon the party
negative: The participant is not obligated to deliver the promised work
No compulsory commitment has been imposed upon the party

positive: A scarce operational asset is committed to execution
The work receives an explicitly limited resource budget
negative: No scarce operational asset is committed to execution
The work receives no limited resource budget

positive: Verified observations back the claim being evaluated
An inspectable proof record justifies the stated conclusion
negative: Verified observations do not back the claim being evaluated
No inspectable proof record justifies the stated conclusion

positive: Execution is restricted to an explicitly scheduled interval
A binding temporal limit applies to the step
negative: Execution is not restricted to any scheduled interval
No binding temporal limit applies to the step

positive: The probability of the eventual result remains unresolved
The evidence leaves multiple interpretations open
negative: The eventual result is known with no remaining uncertainty
The evidence settles one interpretation conclusively

positive: The agreement forbids performing the specified combination
An incompatibility rule excludes joint operation
negative: The agreement permits performing the specified combination
No incompatibility rule excludes joint operation

positive: The specified action produces a binding subsequent outcome
A causal effect follows directly from performing the step
negative: The specified action produces no change in subsequent outcome
No causal effect follows from performing the step
